name: The Soviet Vaults
description: The Archivist has found documentation suggesting the Soviet government ran a parallel vault program before the war. The entrances are listed in the documents she's recovered. One appears to be in the Urals — accessible, but uncontacted for two hundred years.

stages.name: Travel to the Urals
stages.description: Leave Moscow and head east into the Ural Mountain range. The Archivist's documents indicate the vault entrance is in a specific mountain pass that was used as a pre-war military supply route.

stages.name: Find the Vault Entrance
stages.description: The Soviet vault entrance is marked in the Archivist's documents as 'Object 77-S.' Search the mountain pass for the concealed entrance — it was built to survive nuclear strike and remain invisible from the air.

stages.name: Make Contact
stages.description: The vault shows signs of habitation. Announce your presence carefully — inhabitants who have been sealed for two hundred years may not react predictably to the outside world.

stages.name: Report to the Archivist
stages.description: Return to Moscow with what you've learned. The Archivist needs a full account before she decides what to do with the information.
